title: Aura Ore New Elements
description: This texture pack redesigns ores as clean, stylized chemical element tiles from the periodic table. Each ore is replaced with a simple element symbol and its atomic number, giving the game a more scientific and modern look.
body:
This texture pack redesigns ores as clean, stylized chemical element tiles from the periodic table.
Each ore is replaced with a simple element symbol and its atomic number, giving the game a more scientific and modern look.

All ores have been replaced as follows:

Coal — C6
Copper — Cu29
Iron — Fe26
Gold — Au79
Diamond — C6
Emerald — Be4
Redstone — S16
Lapis Lazuli — Na11
Nethergold — Au79
Quartz — Si14
